question: For veg whsle data, can you analyze our financial performance over the years 2020 to 2023? I need insights into the average wholesale price, maximum wholesale price, minimum wholesale price, wholesale price difference, total wholesale price, total selling price, average loss rate, total loss, and profit for each category within each year. Round all calculated values to two decimal places.
sql:
WITH wholesale AS (
  SELECT 
    vw.item_code,
    SUBSTR(vw.whsle_date, 1, 4) AS year_str,
    vw."whsle_px_rmb-kg" AS wholesale_price
  FROM veg_whsle_df vw
  WHERE SUBSTR(vw.whsle_date, 1, 4) IN ('2020','2021','2022','2023')
),
transactions AS (
  SELECT 
    vt.item_code,
    SUBSTR(vt.txn_date, 1, 4) AS year_str,
    vt."qty_sold(kg)" AS qty_sold,
    vt."unit_selling_px_rmb/kg" AS selling_price
  FROM veg_txn_df vt
  WHERE SUBSTR(vt.txn_date, 1, 4) IN ('2020','2021','2022','2023')
    AND vt."sale/return" = 'sale'
),
items AS (
  SELECT 
    vc.item_code,
    vc.category_code,
    vc.category_name,
    vl."loss_rate_%" AS loss_rate
  FROM veg_cat vc
  JOIN veg_loss_rate_df vl ON vc.item_code = vl.item_code
),
wholesale_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    i.category_code,
    i.category_name,
    w.year_str,
    ROUND(AVG(w.wholesale_price), 2) AS avg_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(MAX(w.wholesale_price), 2) AS max_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(MIN(w.wholesale_price), 2) AS min_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(MAX(w.wholesale_price) - MIN(w.wholesale_price), 2) AS wholesale_price_difference
  FROM wholesale w
  JOIN items i ON w.item_code = i.item_code
  GROUP BY i.category_code, i.category_name, w.year_str
),
transaction_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    i.category_code,
    i.category_name,
    t.year_str,
    ROUND(SUM(t.qty_sold * w.wholesale_price), 2) AS total_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(SUM(t.qty_sold * t.selling_price), 2) AS total_selling_price,
    ROUND(AVG(i.loss_rate), 2) AS avg_loss_rate,
    ROUND(SUM(t.qty_sold * w.wholesale_price) * AVG(i.loss_rate) / 100, 2) AS total_loss,
    ROUND(SUM(t.qty_sold * t.selling_price) - SUM(t.qty_sold * w.wholesale_price), 2) AS profit
  FROM transactions t
  JOIN wholesale w ON t.item_code = w.item_code AND t.year_str = w.year_str
  JOIN items i ON t.item_code = i.item_code
  GROUP BY i.category_code, i.category_name, t.year_str
)
SELECT 
  wa.category_code,
  wa.category_name,
  wa.year_str,
  wa.avg_wholesale_price,
  wa.max_wholesale_price,
  wa.min_wholesale_price,
  wa.wholesale_price_difference,
  ta.total_wholesale_price,
  ta.total_selling_price,
  ta.avg_loss_rate,
  ta.total_loss,
  ta.profit
FROM wholesale_agg wa
JOIN transaction_agg ta ON wa.category_code = ta.category_code AND wa.year_str = ta.year_str
ORDER BY wa.category_code, wa.year_str
